二师叔陈泽生笑呵呵的说：“大师兄，你可真舍得呀！这套针你宝贝的让我们看一下都不行，这就送出去了？”

平三卓气呼呼的：“我的东西，我乐意，你管得着吗？”

赵爷爷：“老平，这是不是太珍贵了，要不换一个？”

“一套针而已，不用不用。”

王野见平三卓态度坚决，也就接过针盒。

这只针盒浑身散发着古朴的气息，盒身由深色的檀木制成，木质纹理犹如岁月的脉络，深浅交错。其长宽不过数寸，高约三指，小巧而精致。盒面上，简单地雕刻着几枝梅花，花朵与枝干虽无过多修饰，却栩栩如生，仿佛能闻到那一缕清幽的梅香。铜制的盒扣已有些许斑驳，泛着淡淡的绿锈，轻轻一扣，发出一声低沉而醇厚的“咔哒”声，似是开启了一段被尘封的旧时光。

打开盒盖，里面铺着一层褪了色的绸缎，八枚银针整齐地排列其上，针头在微弱的光线下闪烁着冰冷的光，针身则与盒内的深色形成对比，更显银白。整个针盒，没有华丽的装饰，却凭借着其简约与质朴，承载着往昔的记忆与技艺，让人不禁对那个慢工出细活的古老时代心生向往。

王野恭恭敬敬的收起针盒，拱手谢过平三卓。平三卓翻开桌上的册子：“这是咱这一脉的宗谱。”拿起笔墨在最后一页上加上了王野的名字。写完后，平三卓并没有放下毛笔，而是看向王野，又看了看旁边的小丫头。

王野心里神会：“回师父，这是小妹，叫王笑笑。”

平三卓微微一笑，又在宗谱上写下来了王笑笑的名字。

在众人各种寒暄后，拜师终于结束了，看看时间现在都六点多了。王野看众人的意思，好像没有去吃饭的意思，没办法呀！现在真的没有请客吃饭的意思。可是王野不能就这么看着呀！就对平三卓说：“师父，仪式咱也办完了，可是两位师叔和师兄们都忙活一下午了，我想请吃顿饭，就当是拜师宴了，您看行吗？”

平三卓听见这话，看向了旁边的赵爷爷。赵爷爷没好气的说：“看我干嘛？我也忙活了半天了，我也饿了呀！”

平三卓点点头答应了王野的提议。

接下来，王野就带领众人去了丰泽园，可是一到丰泽园，王野就见到了熟人何大清。距离上次去保定，已经过了十来天了，王野还纳闷怎么没有动静呢。这不就在这儿碰上了，王野安排众人去了包厢，这还是用的赵爷爷的工作证开的包厢。要不其他所有人都没资格进包厢的。点完菜后王野就出了包厢，看见何大清已经在一位厨师的陪同下要出门了。

王野赶紧迎上去叫了一声：“何大爷，你什么时候回的四九城呀？”

何大清这才看见王野：“大侄子，我是今天回来的，先安排一下。”

“何大爷，今天我有客人，就不和您细聊了，有什么需要帮助的，让柱子哥去找我。”

“好勒，爷们儿！有事儿你先忙着，大爷在这儿先谢谢你了！”

“大爷，咱这关系外道了不是。”寒暄了两句王野就回了包厢。

看着一桌子的大餐，众人是相当吃惊，这种席面儿已经好几年没见过了。不是众人没钱，是没票呀。这顿饭吃的那真是宾主尽欢。平三卓和赵爷爷更是高兴，当然要说最高兴的就是王笑笑了。这个小丫头还是第一次吃到这么多的好吃的。整个人都站在了王野的大腿上，指指这个，点点那个。别看小丫头年龄小，但是她真是个人精，她就知道只要自己点哪个，王野就给她喂到嘴里。

王野是真怕把这小丫头撑坏了，赶紧收住了继续投喂的举动。平三卓交代了程启铭两句，大师兄就出去了，没一会儿，程启铭就拿着两个纸盒子回来了，把纸盒递给王野：“小师弟，这是大山楂丸，可以给小......小师妹吃。”

看着程启铭心不甘情不愿叫小丫头师妹，王野就想笑：“谢过大师兄，还要劳烦你跑一趟。”

Second Senior Uncle Chen Zesheng said with a smile: "Senior Brother, you are so willing! You can't even let us take a look at this set of precious needles, so you are giving it away now?"

Ping Sanzhuo said angrily: "My things are my pleasure, can you take care of them?"

Grandpa Zhao: "Lao Ping, is this too precious? How about changing it to another one?"

"It's just a set of needles, no need, no need."

Seeing Ping Sanzhuo's firm attitude, Wang Ye took the needle box.

This needle box exudes a simple atmosphere. The box body is made of dark sandalwood. The wood texture is like the veins of time, with staggered depth and light.Its length and width are only a few inches, and its height is about three fingers. It is small and delicate.On the surface of the box, a few plum blossoms are simply carved. Although the flowers and branches are not too decorated, they are lifelike, as if you can smell the quiet plum fragrance.The copper box buckle was already slightly mottled and had a light green rust. When it was clicked gently, a low and mellow "click" sound was heard, which seemed to open up a dusty old time.

Opening the lid of the box, there was a layer of faded satin inside, with eight silver needles neatly arranged on it. The needles shone coldly in the weak light, and the needle bodies contrasted with the dark color inside the box, making them even more silvery white.The entire needle box has no gorgeous decoration, but with its simplicity and simplicity, it carries the memories and skills of the past, making people yearn for that ancient era of slow work and meticulous work.

Wang Ye put away the needle box respectfully and thanked Ping Sanzhuo.Ping Sanzhuo opened the book on the table: "This is the genealogy of our lineage." He picked up the pen and ink and added Wang Ye's name on the last page.After finishing writing, Ping Sanzhuo did not put down the brush, but looked at Wang Ye and then at the little girl next to him.

Wang Yeli said in a flash: "Go back to Master, this is my little sister, my name is Wang Xiaoxiao."

Ping Sanzhuo smiled slightly and wrote Wang Xiaoxiao's name on the genealogy.

After everyone exchanged pleasantries, the apprenticeship was finally over. It was now past six o'clock.Wang Ye looked at everyone's intentions and seemed to have no intention of going to eat. There was nothing he could do!I really don’t want to treat anyone to dinner now.But Wang Ye can't just look at it like this!He said to Ping Sanzhuo: "Master, we have finished the ceremony, but the two uncles and senior brothers have been busy all afternoon. I would like to treat you to a meal, and treat it as an apprenticeship banquet. Do you think that is okay?"

Hearing this, Ping Sanzhuo looked at Grandpa Zhao next to him.Grandpa Zhao said angrily: "What are you looking at me for? I've been busy for a long time, and I'm hungry too!"

Ping Sanzhuo nodded and agreed to Wang Ye's proposal.

Next, Wang Ye led everyone to Fengze Garden, but as soon as he arrived at Fengze Garden, Wang Ye saw an acquaintance, He Daqing.It had been more than ten days since the last time he went to Baoding, and Wang Ye was still wondering why there was no movement.We met here, Wang Ye arranged for everyone to go to the box, which was opened with Grandpa Zhao's work permit.Otherwise, no one else would be eligible to enter the box.After ordering, Wang Ye came out of the box and saw He Daqing already going out accompanied by a chef.

Wang Ye quickly went up to him and called out: "Uncle He, when did you return to Sijiu City?"

Only then did He Daqing see Wang Ye: "Nephew, I'm back today. Let's make some arrangements first."

"Uncle He, I have guests today, so I won't talk to you in detail. If you need any help, let Brother Zhuzi find me."

"Okay, sir! If you have something to do, you should be busy first. I'm here to thank you in advance!"

"Uncle, our relationship is a heretic, aren't we?" After a few words of greeting, Wang Ye returned to the box.

Everyone was quite surprised when they saw the feast on the table. They had not seen this kind of meal for several years.It’s not that everyone has no money, it’s that they don’t have tickets.This meal was truly a feast for both the guest and the host.Ping Sanzhuo and Grandpa Zhao were even more happy. Of course, the happiest person was Wang Xiaoxiao.This is the first time this little girl has eaten so much delicious food.Everyone stood on Wang Ye's lap, pointing at this and that.Even though the little girl is young, she is really a smart person. She knows which one she orders and Wang Ye will feed it to her mouth.

Wang Ye was really afraid of overstretching the little girl, so he quickly stopped feeding her.Ping Sanzhuo told Cheng Qiming a few words, and the senior brother went out. After a while, Cheng Qiming came back with two cartons and handed the cartons to Wang Ye: "Junior brother, this is a big hawthorn pill, you can give it to...little junior sister."

Seeing that Cheng Qiming was unwilling to call the little girl junior sister, Wang Ye wanted to laugh: "Thank you, senior brother, but I have to trouble you to make a trip."
